prompt: Perform a comprehensive Fractional CFO Close Certification & Fixed Assets review using the world files (`solguard_9mo_close_and_depreciation_2026_Q3.xlsx`). World 106 Task A  -  SolGuard 9-Month Cumulative Depreciation True-Up & Drift Marker Audit:
1. Commit Runs & Depreciation: Across commit runs 648, 650, 651, and 652, there are 128 reviewed actions and 9-month cumulative depreciation on GL 47 of $10,023.26 ($3,341.08 + $3,341.09 + $2,227.39 + $1,113.70), with all runs showing CLEARED_POST_RESYNC.
2. Financial Tie-Out: YTD Net Loss is -$867,814.31 ($867,814.31 net loss), QBO Bank Cash is $4,260,214.72, and Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity = $4,303,865.40 (matched to $4,303,865.40).
3. Close Gate & Bank-Statement Guardrail: Open uncategorized balance is $0.00 with 18/19 close checks complete. Because Bank_Statement_Attached=false, the $4,260,214.72 QBO Bank Cash figure cannot be certified as a completed external bank-statement reconciliation.
